flow.text:
Flow

First launch: Onboarding (3 pages) → Sign-up (name and number, then the 6-digit text code) → Mascot picker → Home

On a call, app open: Call offer → Share screen → share sheet → Live map. Alerts are asked right after the first link is sent.

On a call, app closed: Quick start → Share screen

Manual: Home → Share screen → share sheet → Live map

Stop sharing → Sharing ended → Home

The person on the call opens the link → Viewer · live

Not in v1: Contacts, Share history, SOS

Concept: the prototype is the reference

The click-through prototype (prototype/index.html) is the screen reference for v1. These Live Together screens are concept art, dark only, kept in sync with it: same moments and wording, colors taken from the dark token values.

lt-how.text:
How it works

1. During the call, Alex opens the share screen (from the call offer or Quick start), keeps “Let them share back” on and sends the link.
2. Mom opens the link and sees Alex live, with where Alex is in words (“Near Market Street”), Show Alex and Open in Maps.
3. Alex can tap Ask to share, once per call. Mom taps Share my location, and the browser asks once.
4. Both maps now show both people and the distance between them.
5. Alex goes back to the call: the green call pill in the status bar on iPhone, Back to call on Android. A mini map (Android; tap it for expand, close and stop) or the Live Activity (iOS) keeps them in view.

Share back always stops when the call ends.
